product_overview: Sipariş Takip Sistemi, telefonla sipariş alan işletmeler için Supabase destekli masaüstü bir sipariş yönetim uygulamasıdır. Müşteri, ürün, kurye, arama ve sipariş süreçlerini tek ekranda yönetir; gerektiğinde adisyon yazdırır ve kurye uygulamalarıyla entegre çalışır.
core_goals: Telefonla gelen siparişleri masaüstünde hızlı şekilde yönetmek
Müşteri, adres, ürün, kategori ve kurye verilerini merkezi olarak CRUD ile yönetmek
Sipariş yaşam döngüsünü oluşturma, güncelleme, atama, teslim ve silme adımlarıyla izlemek
Gelen aramaları müşteri kayıtlarıyla eşleştirip işlenmesini takip etmek
Kuryeler için günlük sipariş ve teslimat özetlerini sağlamak
Adisyon önizleme ve ESC/POS yazıcı çıktısı üretmek
Misafir müşteriler ve tek seferlik sipariş akışını desteklemek

features.name: Customer Management
features.description: Telefon bazlı arama, yeni müşteri ekleme, güncelleme, listeleme ve silme işlemleri ile müşteri kayıtlarını yönetir.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/customers with auth and search parameters -> Receive 200 with Customer[] -> Select a customer and GET /rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with Customer
POST /rest/v1/customers with valid name, phone, and is_guest=false -> Receive 201 with created Customer -> GET /rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with saved customer
POST /rest/v1/customers with a phone number already used by another customer -> Receive 409 Duplicate phone conflict
PATCH /rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{id} with updated name and phone -> Receive 200 with updated Customer -> GET /rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with latest data
DELETE /rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{id} for a customer with no blocking dependencies -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/customers?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with no record

features.name: Customer Address Management
features.description: Customers can have multiple delivery addresses, including a default address and optional geolocation data.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/customer_addresses?customer_id=eq.{id} with auth -> Receive 200 with Address[] -> POST /rest/v1/customer_addresses with customer_id, title, address_text, and is_default -> Receive 201 with created Address
POST /rest/v1/customer_addresses with invalid or missing customer_id -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/customer_addresses?customer_id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with unchanged Address[]
PATCH /rest/v1/customer_addresses?id=eq.{id} with new address_text and default flag -> Receive 200 with updated Address
DELETE /rest/v1/customer_addresses?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/customer_addresses?customer_id=eq.{customer_id} -> Receive 200 with remaining addresses

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Product categories can be created, ordered, edited, and removed to organize the product catalog.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/categories with auth -> Receive 200 with Category[] ordered by sort_order -> POST /rest/v1/categories with name, color, and sort_order -> Receive 201 with created Category
POST /rest/v1/categories with missing required name -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/categories -> Receive 200 with existing categories unchanged
PATCH /rest/v1/categories?id=eq.{id} with updated name or color -> Receive 200 with updated Category
DELETE /rest/v1/categories?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/categories -> Receive 200 with category removed or no longer returned

features.name: Product Management
features.description: Products are managed under categories with price, unit, and display order for use in order creation.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/products with auth and optional active filter -> Receive 200 with Product[] joined to categories -> POST /rest/v1/products with name, price, unit, category_id, and sort_order -> Receive 201 with created Product
POST /rest/v1/products with invalid category_id or missing price -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/products -> Receive 200 with unchanged Product[]
PATCH /rest/v1/products?id=eq.{id} with updated price, unit, or category_id -> Receive 200 with updated Product
DELETE /rest/v1/products?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/products -> Receive 200 with product removed

features.name: Courier Management
features.description: Couriers can be created, activated, updated, listed, and deleted to support delivery assignment and tracking.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/couriers with auth and optional active-only filter -> Receive 200 with Courier[] -> POST /rest/v1/couriers with name, phone, password, and is_active -> Receive 201 with created Courier
POST /rest/v1/couriers with missing phone or invalid payload -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/couriers -> Receive 200 with existing couriers unchanged
PATCH /rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{id} with updated name, phone, or is_active -> Receive 200 with updated Courier
DELETE /rest/v1/couriers?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/couriers -> Receive 200 with courier removed

features.name: Order Management
features.description: Orders can be created, listed, updated, assigned to couriers, marked by status, paid, and deleted through the full lifecycle.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/orders with date, status, or courier filters -> Receive 200 with Order[] including customer and address joins -> POST /rest/v1/orders with customer_id, address_id, courier_id, status, order_date, payment_method, and notes -> Receive 201 with created Order
POST /rest/v1/orders with missing customer_id or invalid status -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/orders -> Receive 200 with no new order created
PATCH /rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{id} to update status, payment, or courier assignment -> Receive 200 with updated Order -> GET /rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with refreshed order details
DELETE /rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with no record

features.name: Order Items Management
features.description: Order line items are attached to orders in bulk and can be replaced by deleting and reinserting items.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/order_items?order_id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with OrderItem[] and product details -> POST /rest/v1/order_items with order_id, product_id, quantity, unit, and unit_price -> Receive 201 with created OrderItem[]
POST /rest/v1/order_items with invalid product_id or zero quantity -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/order_items?order_id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 with unchanged items
DELETE /rest/v1/order_items?order_id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> POST /rest/v1/order_items with replacement line items -> Receive 201 with new OrderItem[]

features.name: Incoming Calls Tracking
features.description: Incoming phone calls are listed, enriched with customer data, marked processed/unanswered, and removed when needed.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/incoming_calls with auth -> Receive 200 with IncomingCall[] joined to customers and device names -> PATCH /rest/v1/incoming_calls?id=eq.{id} with is_processed=true -> Receive 200 with updated IncomingCall
PATCH /rest/v1/incoming_calls?id=eq.{id} with invalid call id -> Receive 4xx error -> GET /rest/v1/incoming_calls -> Receive 200 with call still pending
DELETE /rest/v1/incoming_calls?id=eq.{id} -> Receive 200 empty -> GET /rest/v1/incoming_calls -> Receive 200 with call record removed

features.name: Courier App RPC
features.description: Courier-facing RPC endpoints provide today's orders, delivery summary, and delivery address location saving.
user_flows: POST /rest/v1/rpc/courier_get_orders with p_courier_id -> Receive 200 with today's orders, customer data, address, and items -> POST /rest/v1/rpc/courier_daily_summary with p_courier_id -> Receive 200 with delivered_count, total_amount, and paid_amount
POST /rest/v1/rpc/courier_save_address_location with p_address_id, p_courier_id, p_latitude, and p_longitude -> Receive 200 with success boolean

POST /rest/v1/rpc/courier_get_orders with invalid p_courier_id -> Receive 4xx or empty result -> POST /rest/v1/rpc/courier_daily_summary with invalid courier -> Receive 200 with zeroed or empty summary depending on data
